nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height). Default is 1 megapixel (1024*1024). For native 2K, set 1:1 and 4 megapixels (2048*2048). Prefer multiples of 32.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

---
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

---
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official  pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

- resolution is a total pixel budget (not width or height). Aspect ratio is preserved.
- Official default is 1024. The model supports up to 2048.
- This template starts at 0: no resize beyond a multiple of 32.
- Output follows image_1. Extra refs can differ in size or aspect.
- custom_size off: canvas comes from the encode latent (image_1).
- custom_size on: use ResolutionSelector width/height. Keep it close to the resized image_1 size, or the edit can shift.

## Reference images
- Up to 10 reference images (image_1 to image_10).
- Mention them in the prompt as `<image1>`, `<image2>`, ...
- image_1 is the edit target. The rest are references.

## Custom settings
If you need custom settings, enter or unpack the subgraph to edit it. See the [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph) guide.

## Parameters
- prompt: edit instruction. Use `<image1>` ... `<image10>`.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

widgets_values: A dramatic studio portrait of an albino woman with luminous yellow eyes and distinctive facial structure, captured in three-quarter view. Her features are crystalline in detail - sculpted nose, expressive lips painted with shimmering golden lipstick, and high cheekbones catching the light. Her light Afro is cut into a sophisticated pixie style. She is surrounded by flowing white grass stalks, with a minimalist white desert landscape visible behind her. Professional lighting creates cinematic contrast, while a shallow depth of field isolates her from the ethereal background. Shot with studio strobes and diffusers.
